name: @azure-sdk/custom-code-metrics-schema
description: TypeSpec contracts, publishing tools and static dashboard for custom code metrics.

scripts.generate: npm run compile && node --experimental-strip-types schema.ts generate
scripts.check: tsp format --check main.tsp && npm run compile && node --experimental-strip-types schema.ts check
scripts.test:publishing: npm run build:publishing && node --experimental-strip-types --test dashboard/tests/report.test.ts tests/publishing.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run build:publishing && node --experimental-strip-types --test dashboard/tests/data.test.ts dashboard/tests/report.test.ts tests/*.test.ts
